name: io.github.sweir1/apple-notes-brain
title: Apple Notes Brain
description: Apple Notes MCP server: read, write, and search Apple Notes on macOS with full Markdown round-trip. Reads via SQLite (sub-100ms, concurrent with Notes.app), writes via AppleScript (preserves iCloud sync). No plugin or fork required.

environmentVariables.name: NOTES_MCP_AUTO_REFRESH
environmentVariables.description: Set to '0' to disable the background auto-refresh thread that pings Notes.app to keep the SQLite cache fresh while the MCP client is active. Default '1' (enabled).

environmentVariables.name: NOTES_MCP_REFRESH_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Background auto-refresh cadence in seconds (default 4, minimum 1). Lower = fresher reads of edits made outside the MCP, higher CPU. Has no effect on writes (those auto-flush regardless).

environmentVariables.name: NOTES_MCP_IDLE_THRESHOLD
environmentVariables.description: Seconds of MCP-tool inactivity before the background auto-refresh pauses (default 300 = 5 minutes). Set to 0 to disable idle pausing entirely. Next tool call instantly wakes the refresher.
